status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al-Shabaab gunmen ambushed road construction workers on the Arabia-Lafey road in Mandera, killing eight, including two police reservists, and also stormed the Mjengo site, killing at least eight more. Somali security forces opened fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing three civilians, while a former prime minister accused the government of cutting payments to 10,000 soldiers and families. President Mohamud declared fighting Al-Shabaab a top priority in Jowhar, and regional leaders warned of consequences if federal troops attack the Hiiraan region. Egypt, Somalia and Djibouti held talks reaffirming their exclusive role in securing the Red Sea waterway. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab-skytere ambuerte veiarbeidere på Arabia-Lafey-veien i Mandera, og drepte åtte, inkludert to politireservister, og stormet også Mjengo-stedet, hvor de drepte minst åtte til. Somaliske sikkerhetsstyrker skjøt på demonstranter i Mogadishu, og drepte tre sivile, mens en tidligere statsminister anklaget regjeringen for å kutte utbetalinger til 10 000 soldater og familier. President Mohamud erklærte kamp mot Al-Shabaab som en topp prioritet i Jowhar, og regionale ledere advarte om konsekvenser dersom føderale tropper angriper Hiiraan-regionen. Egypt, Somalia og Djibouti holdt samtaler der de bekreftet sin eksklusive rolle i sikringen av Rødehavsfarvannet. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
